How to use this plan

🔍Search

Tap Search the plan and type a word like "halal", "museum" or "Sentosa". Only matching places stay on screen.

✨Adjust my plan

Raining, tired or found a new idea? Pick a day, say what changed, and the day is rewritten for you. Undo steps back one change, Restore original resets the day.

💸Estimated budget

See tickets and transport separately, with totals. Switch people, car or MRT, and SGD, IDR, USD or EUR.

✎My review

After each stop, mark it visited, give it stars and add a note. It is saved on your phone.

➡️Pages

Use the tabs at the top, or the Up next button at the bottom of each page: Home, Day 1 to 5, More, Trip recap.

🎉Trip recap

At the end, open the last page for your trip story: places, steps, spending, calories, best spot and badges. Tap Make my Instagram story to share it on social media.

What to look at in the plan

  • 💰 Paid🎟️ Free entry☕ Pay for what you order The badge under each stop shows what it costs to get in.
  • Purple barPink stripes On each place's hours bar: purple is when it's open, pink is when it's usually busy. Hover or slide your finger along it to see the time.
  • ⛈️ Rain likely 2 to 6 PM The weather chips show typical rain times for late November. Plan indoor stops for the afternoon.
  • Before you go Each day ends with tips, plus how to get there by car (parking, ERP) or by MRT.
  • HalalCheck porkPork on menu Food tags help you choose quickly. Always check with staff.
  • EST. Prices marked est. are typical spends, not menu prices.

Indonesia: Bali, 7 days

A week on the island. Book boats, Mount Batur and Gili tours ahead of time. Opening hours and prices change, so check on the day.

Day 1: Arrive in Seminyak

Settle in, then watch the sunset at Double Six Beach. Dinner at Potato Head Beach Club.
Tags: beach, restaurant

Day 2: Canggu

Morning surf lesson at Batu Bolong Beach. Brunch at Clear Cafe. Sunset at Echo Beach.
Tags: beach, cafe, activity

Day 3: Ubud

Walk the Campuhan Ridge, then visit Tegallalang rice terraces and the Monkey Forest. Dinner at Locavore.
Tags: activity, restaurant

Day 4: Kintamani and Mount Batur

Early start for the sunrise trek up Mount Batur with a guide. Breakfast with the volcano view at Kintamani, then the drive back to Ubud.
Tags: activity, viewpoint

Day 5: Gili Islands or Nusa Lembongan (choose one)

Take a fast boat from Sanur or Padangbai. On Gili Trawangan, get around by bicycle, since motorbikes are not allowed. On Lembongan, visit Dream Beach and the mangroves. Snorkel and have a beachfront lunch.
Tags: beach, activity

Day 6: Uluwatu

Visit Padang Padang or Bingin Beach in the morning. Watch the sunset at Uluwatu Temple, then the Kecak fire dance.
Tags: beach, activity

Day 7: Back to Seminyak

Last swim at Seminyak, spa and shopping, then dinner before your flight.
Tags: beach, restaurant

🚗 Getting around: car first, MRT as backup
Each day's "Driving route" button opens Google Maps for driving, and the "MRT route" button gives the public transport option. City roads have ERP (electronic road pricing) charges at busy times, and most malls and attractions have paid car parks. Driving into Sentosa adds a vehicle entry charge at the gantry. Never drive after drinking: on bar and club nights, take Grab or a taxi home.
🚇 Paying for the MRT as a visitor
  • Easiest: your own card. Tap a contactless Visa, Mastercard or Amex, or Apple Pay or Google Pay, at the gate. No ticket to buy, same fare as locals. Overseas cards pay a small admin fee of about S$0.60 per travel day, plus any foreign-transaction fee from your bank.
  • Or buy an EZ-Link card for about S$10 (S$5 card plus S$5 credit) at MRT ticket offices, 7-Eleven or SimplyGo counters, including at Changi Airport. Top up at station machines. The gate shows your balance each time.
  • Singapore Tourist Pass (unlimited rides): about S$17 for 1 day to S$45 for 5 days. It only pays off if you take 5 or more rides a day.
  • Tip: always tap in and out with the same card or phone. Most rides cost about S$1.30 to S$2.60.
📱 Cheapest ride apps
  • No single app is always cheapest, so install two or three and compare the final total before booking. Uber doesn't run in Singapore.
  • Ryde: usually the lowest booking fees, often cheapest for short trips. It adds extra fees on foreign cards, so pay cash if you can.
  • TADA: commission-free with steady prices, good outside rush hour.
  • Gojek: often runs promos. Grab: the most cars and the most reliable, but surges at peak times. CDG Zig: metered taxis, handy for the airport.
  • Save more: avoid 8 to 9:30 AM and 6 to 8 PM, and look for first-ride promo codes.

Day 3: Morning walk, culture, then Kampong Glam

Before you go
Go up Ann Siang Hill early, before it gets busy and hot. Both museums open at 10 AM.

🚗 By car
Parking in Chinatown is tight, so use a mall car park such as Chinatown Point or People's Park. The National Museum has its own car park, and you can walk from there to the Peranakan Museum on Armenian Street. For Haji Lane, park at a Bugis mall car park and walk over.

🚇 By MRT
Ann Siang Hill: Telok Ayer or Maxwell MRT. National Museum: Bras Basah or Dhoby Ghaut MRT. Haji Lane: Bugis MRT.

Good to know
Tourists pay museum entry, so buy tickets online or at the counter. Allow 2 to 3 hours per museum.
Afternoons are often rainy: bring a small umbrella; the museums make a good rain shelter.
Near Haji Lane is Sultan Mosque. Dress modestly if you visit, and avoid prayer times.
Haji Lane shops start closing in the evening, but cafes and bars stay open later.

Park at Resorts World Sentosa for Visions of Magic, then drive to Chinatown for the temples and dinner. You'll be drinking tonight, so park the car before the bars, or leave it at home and take Grab. Don't drive home after drinks.

Sentosa Express to HarbourFront, then the MRT to Chinatown. Clarke Quay is one MRT stop away, or about a 15-minute walk.

Before you go
Leave home by 12:30 PM. If you visit the Merlion and the Flyer, leave Marina Bay by about 11:30 AM. Keep your passport and flight details handy.

🚗 By car
Park at the Marina Bay Sands car park, and walk to the Merlion and the Flyer. Changi is about 20 minutes away by car. If someone is dropping you off, use the Departures drop-off point at your terminal.

🚇 By MRT
Bayfront MRT is beside Marina Bay Sands. To reach Changi, take the East-West Line and change at Tanah Merah for the airport branch. Allow about an hour.
